name: Yomogita (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yomogita village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised arrow pointing to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Yomogita, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1980.

features.role: Yomogita village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised arrow pointing to the fly
